title: もし～ても
shortExplanation: Express a hypothetical situation or assumption with the nuance of 'even if'.
longExplanation: The もし～ても grammar point is used to describe a situation in which even if the stated condition is true, the result or decision does not change. It can be translated as 'even if', 'no matter if', or 'suppose ~'.
formation: もし + Verb-て form + も / もし + い-Adjective(く) + ても / もし + な-Adjective/Noun + でも

examples.jp: もし雨が降っても、ピクニックに行きます。
examples.romaji: Moshi ame ga futtemo, pikunikku ni ikimasu.
examples.en: Even if it rains, we will go on a picnic.

examples.jp: もし彼が謝っても、まだ怒っているでしょう。
examples.romaji: Moshi kare ga ayamattemo, mada okotteiru deshou.
examples.en: Even if he apologizes, I will still be angry.

words.reading: おこっているでしょう

examples.jp: もし試験に合格しても、まだ勉強を続けます。
examples.romaji: Moshi shiken ni goukaku shitemo, mada benkyou wo tsuzukemasu.
examples.en: Even if I pass the exam, I will still continue studying.

examples.jp: もし彼女が遅く来ても、待っています。
examples.romaji: Moshi kanojo ga osoku kite mo, matteimasu.
examples.en: Even if she comes late, I will wait.

usageNote: Pairs もし with ても - a plain hypothetical "even if".
